entries.name: Convex deployment
entries.description: The Convex backend that runs every query, mutation, action, and HTTP action.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. No deployment identity ships.
entries.unsetBehavior: The app cannot reach a backend. Nothing loads or saves.
entries.setBy: Create a Convex deployment and provision its schema and functions with the Convex CLI.

entries.name: Google OAuth client
entries.description: The Google Cloud OAuth client that powers Google sign-in and Drive access.
entries.unsetBehavior: Google sign-in and the Drive picker fail. Optional if you do not use Google.
entries.setBy: Create an OAuth client in Google Cloud, then set the GOOGLE_OAUTH_* and NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_* variables listed below.

entries.name: First platform admin
entries.description: The first administrator account. Signup is invite-only and closed until one admin exists.
entries.unsetBehavior: No one can sign up, so no one can administer the deployment.
entries.setBy: Run the admin-key-gated internal mutation users:bootstrapFirstPlatformAdmin with a username, then sign in and set a password.

entries.name: Primary institution
entries.description: The default institution rows (primary school plus guests) the app expects to exist.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. No institution rows ship.
entries.unsetBehavior: The app has no institution to place users in until you seed one.
entries.setBy: Run the internal mutation institutions:ensureDefaults once against the deployment.

entries.name: Convex URLs (web)
entries.description: The web app's addresses for the backend: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL for queries and websockets, NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_SITE_URL for HTTP actions.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. No deployment URLs ship.
entries.unsetBehavior: The web app has no backend to talk to and fails to start.
entries.setBy: Set both to your Convex deployment's .convex.cloud and .convex.site URLs before building the web app.

entries.name: Backend app origin
entries.description: The absolute origin the Convex backend uses to build links, such as invite and magic-link URLs.
entries.unsetBehavior: Any backend feature that emits a link throws when it runs; invites and magic links cannot be generated.
entries.setBy: Set SITE_URL in the Convex deployment's environment to your web app's public origin.

entries.name: Web app origin
entries.description: The web app's own public origin, used for page metadata and canonical links.
entries.unsetBehavior: Page metadata and absolute links point at the wrong or a missing origin.
entries.setBy: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to your web app's public origin at build time.

entries.name: Convex URL (native)
entries.description: The iPad app's address for the Convex backend. EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_SITE_URL optionally overrides the HTTP-actions origin.
entries.unsetBehavior: The native app throws at startup ('EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is not set') and does not launch.
entries.setBy: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL (and optionally EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_SITE_URL) in native/.env before building the app.

entries.name: Native web origin
entries.description: The web origin the iPad app embeds for webview surfaces and the offline network probe.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. The code falls back to https://rabbithole.school.
entries.unsetBehavior: Native web embeds and the offline probe silently point at https://rabbithole.school instead of your site.
entries.setBy: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_RABBITHOLE_WEB_URL in native/.env to your web app's origin.

entries.name: Anthropic API key
entries.description: The key for Anthropic Claude, which powers the tutor and the observer analysis.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: The tutor and observer produce no responses.
entries.setBy: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: OpenAI API key
entries.description: The key for OpenAI, used for voice transcription (Whisper), text-to-speech, and the charm-layer image generation that draws badges, flair, and manipulative sprites.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: Voice dictation, speech playback, and generated badge/flair/sprite art do not work; text still works.
entries.setBy: Set OPENAI_API_KEY in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: Google Gemini API key
entries.description: The key for Google's Gemini image model, used for tutor-generated illustrations and image annotation.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: Tutor image generation and annotation are disabled; the rest of the app works. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set GEMINI_API_KEY in the Convex deployment's environment if you want tutor image generation.

entries.name: Auth signing key
entries.description: The PKCS#8 RSA signing key @convex-dev/auth uses to sign session tokens.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: Authentication cannot issue sessions; no one can sign in.
entries.setBy: Generate an RSA-2048 keypair and set its PKCS#8 private PEM as JWT_PRIVATE_KEY in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: Auth verification keys
entries.description: The JSON Web Key Set @convex-dev/auth uses to verify session tokens.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: Authentication cannot verify sessions; no one stays signed in.
entries.setBy: Set JWKS to a JSON Web Key Set containing the RS256 public JWK for JWT_PRIVATE_KEY.

entries.name: Passkey relying-party id
entries.description: The WebAuthn relying-party id (a domain) passkeys are bound to.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. The code defaults to localhost.
entries.unsetBehavior: Passkeys register against localhost and will not work on your real domain.
entries.setBy: Set PASSKEY_RP_ID in the Convex deployment's environment to your production domain.

entries.name: Passkey origin
entries.description: The allowed WebAuthn origin(s) for passkey ceremonies, comma-separated.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. The code defaults to localhost origins.
entries.unsetBehavior: Passkey ceremonies are only accepted from localhost.
entries.setBy: Set PASSKEY_ORIGIN in the Convex deployment's environment to your production origin(s).

entries.name: Passkey display name
entries.description: The human label shown in the operating system's passkey prompt.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. The code defaults to 'Rabbithole'.
entries.unsetBehavior: The passkey prompt shows 'Rabbithole' instead of your school's name.
entries.setBy: Set PASSKEY_RP_NAME in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: Email API key
entries.description: The Resend API key used to send magic-link sign-in email.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: Magic-link email is not sent; the sign-in URL is only logged. Optional if you do not use email sign-in.
entries.setBy: Set AUTH_RESEND_KEY in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: Email sender identity
entries.description: The full From identity for system email, such as 'Rabbithole <no-reply@mail.example.org>'.
entries.unsetBehavior: Sending system email throws because no sender is configured. Required once email sending is on.
entries.setBy: Set AUTH_EMAIL_FROM in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: Family-facing sender
entries.description: Optional mailbox for family-facing parent messages; AUTH_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS is an accepted alias. Defaults to a family-facing form of AUTH_EMAIL_FROM.
entries.unsetBehavior: Parent messages are sent from a family-facing form of AUTH_EMAIL_FROM. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set PARENT_MESSAGE_FROM (or AUTH_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS) in the Convex deployment's environment to override the sender mailbox.

entries.name: Mapbox token (web)
entries.description: The Mapbox access token used to render maps in the web app.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Adopters must supply their own; see NOTICE.
entries.unsetBehavior: Map surfaces render a tokenless empty state; the rest of the app works. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN at build time to your Mapbox token.

entries.name: Mapbox token (native)
entries.description: The Mapbox access token used to render maps in the iPad app.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Adopters must supply their own; see NOTICE.
entries.unsetBehavior: Native map cards render a tokenless empty state; the rest of the app works. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN in native/.env to your Mapbox token.

entries.name: Google OAuth client id
entries.description: The OAuth client id for backend Google sign-in and Drive access.
entries.unsetBehavior: Backend Google OAuth throws when used. Optional if you do not use Google.
entries.setBy: Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: Google OAuth client secret
entries.description: The OAuth client secret paired with GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: Backend Google OAuth throws when used. Optional if you do not use Google.
entries.setBy: Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: Google OAuth redirect
entries.description: The redirect URI registered on the Google OAuth client.
entries.unsetBehavior: Backend Google OAuth throws when used. Optional if you do not use Google.
entries.setBy: Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI in the Convex deployment's environment to a URI registered on your OAuth client.

entries.name: Google OAuth state secret
entries.description: The secret used to sign the OAuth state parameter.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Falls back to JWT_PRIVATE_KEY.
entries.unsetBehavior: The OAuth state is signed with JWT_PRIVATE_KEY instead. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_STATE_SECRET in the Convex deployment's environment to use a dedicated secret.

entries.name: Google Picker API key
entries.description: The browser API key the web Google Drive picker uses.
entries.unsetBehavior: The web Drive picker cannot open. Optional if you do not use the picker.
entries.setBy: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_API_KEY at build time.

entries.name: Google Picker client id
entries.description: The browser OAuth client id the web Google Drive picker uses.
entries.unsetBehavior: The web Drive picker cannot authorize. Optional if you do not use the picker.
entries.setBy: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID at build time.

entries.name: Drive webhook base URL
entries.description: The absolute base URL Google Drive push notifications are delivered to.
entries.unsetBehavior: Drive webhook registration throws when used. Optional if you do not use Drive change notifications.
entries.setBy: Set DRIVE_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL in the Convex deployment's environment to an absolute HTTPS URL.

entries.name: Google Drive change events
entries.description: The Google Cloud Pub/Sub settings for Drive change events: GOOGLE_EVENTS_PROJECT, GOOGLE_EVENTS_TOPIC, GOOGLE_EVENTS_PUSH_SECRET, and GOOGLE_EVENTS_PUSH_SA.
entries.unsetBehavior: Drive change-event subscriptions do not work. Optional if you do not use them.
entries.setBy: Set GOOGLE_EVENTS_PROJECT, GOOGLE_EVENTS_TOPIC, GOOGLE_EVENTS_PUSH_SECRET, and GOOGLE_EVENTS_PUSH_SA in the Convex deployment's environment.

entries.name: SimpleMDM API key
entries.description: The API key for the SimpleMDM device-management integration.
entries.unsetBehavior: Device-management features stay off; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set SIMPLEMDM_API_KEY in the Convex deployment's environment if you run a SimpleMDM tenant.

entries.name: Slack signing secret
entries.description: The signing secret that verifies inbound Slack event requests.
entries.unsetBehavior: The Slack events endpoint returns 503 and the bot stays off; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET in the Convex deployment's environment if you run the Slack bot.

entries.name: Slack bot token
entries.description: The bot token used to call the Slack Web API.
entries.unsetBehavior: Slack calls are skipped and the bot stays off; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set SLACK_BOT_TOKEN in the Convex deployment's environment if you run the Slack bot.

entries.name: Slack workshop channel
entries.description: The channel id the bot posts workshop notifications to.
entries.unsetBehavior: Workshop notifications are not posted; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set SLACK_WORKSHOP_CHANNEL_ID in the Convex deployment's environment if you run the Slack bot.

entries.name: Resend webhook secret
entries.description: The secret verifying inbound Resend email webhooks for parent messaging.
entries.unsetBehavior: Inbound parent email is not processed; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the Convex deployment's environment if you use inbound parent email.

entries.name: Resend receiving key
entries.description: The Resend API key used to read inbound parent email.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: Inbound parent email cannot be fetched; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set RESEND_RECEIVING_API_KEY in the Convex deployment's environment if you use inbound parent email.

entries.name: Parent inbound domain
entries.description: The email domain inbound parent messages are received on.
entries.unsetBehavior: Inbound parent email addressing does not resolve; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set PARENT_INBOUND_DOMAIN in the Convex deployment's environment if you use inbound parent email.

entries.name: Parent inbound secret
entries.description: The secret validating inbound parent-message addresses.
entries.unsetBehavior: Inbound parent email validation is off; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set PARENT_INBOUND_SECRET in the Convex deployment's environment if you use inbound parent email.

entries.name: School WhatsApp number
entries.description: The WhatsApp number parent messages are sent from and received on.
entries.unsetBehavior: WhatsApp parent messaging stays off; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set SCHOOL_WHATSAPP_NUMBER in the Convex deployment's environment if you use WhatsApp messaging.

entries.name: WhatsApp credentials
entries.description: The WhatsApp Cloud API credential and template settings: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET, WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME, and WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_LANG.
entries.publishedAs: Not present. Secrets are never published.
entries.unsetBehavior: WhatsApp parent messaging stays off; nothing else is affected. Optional.
entries.setBy: Set the WHATSAPP_* variables in the Convex deployment's environment if you use WhatsApp messaging.

entries.name: Institution brand
entries.description: Your school's name, logo, tagline, and contact details for printed materials.
entries.publishedAs: A neutral 'Rabbithole' identity with no logo or contact details.
entries.unsetBehavior: Printed forms and branded surfaces show 'Rabbithole' and omit your logo and contacts.
entries.setBy: Replace the values in PRIMARY_INSTITUTION_BRAND with your school's identity.

entries.name: Institution prompt profile
entries.description: Your school's identity as the tutor and observer see it: name, short name, location, and time zone.
entries.publishedAs: A neutral 'Rabbithole' profile located nowhere, in UTC.
entries.unsetBehavior: The tutor refers to a generic school and reasons about time in UTC.
entries.setBy: Replace the values in PRIMARY_INSTITUTION_PROMPT_PROFILE with your school's identity and time zone.

entries.name: Institution print identity
entries.description: The issuing authority named in the header of printed materials such as calculator licenses.
entries.unsetBehavior: Printed materials are headed 'Rabbithole' rather than your school's name.
entries.setBy: Replace issuingAuthority in PRIMARY_INSTITUTION_PRINT_IDENTITY with your school's name.

entries.name: Institution seal
entries.description: The base64 PNG seal stamped on printed documents.
entries.unsetBehavior: Printed documents carry no seal.
entries.setBy: Replace primaryInstitutionSealPngBase64 with your school's seal as a base64 PNG.

entries.name: Native app identity
entries.description: The iPad app's identity: bundle identifier, URL scheme, display name, and icons. Signing (team and credentials) is configured separately in your own build setup, not in this file.
entries.publishedAs: Neutral 'Rabbithole' values with the bundle id 'org.rabbithole.app' and no signing configuration.
entries.unsetBehavior: You cannot sign or distribute the app under your own identity, and you clash with the placeholder bundle id.
entries.setBy: Set ios.bundleIdentifier, scheme, name, and the icon assets in native/app.json, and configure iOS signing in your build pipeline.

entries.name: Universal-link hosts
entries.description: The web hostnames whose /open/* links the iPad app claims as Apple universal links.
entries.unsetBehavior: Universal links are ignored. Everything else works.
entries.setBy: Add your hostname to UNIVERSAL_LINK_HOSTS, and to ios.associatedDomains in native/app.json.

entries.name: Default time zone
entries.description: The fallback calendar time zone for institutions with no time zone set. Sibling fallbacks appear in several schedule and scholar surfaces.
entries.unsetBehavior: Dates and day boundaries are computed in Pacific/Honolulu until you change DEFAULT_TIMEZONE and its siblings.
entries.setBy: Set DEFAULT_TIMEZONE in shared/institutionDay.ts to your region, and update the matching fallbacks noted in the file.

entries.name: Device-unlock bundle namespace
entries.description: The app bundle-id namespace the device-management unlock logic treats as this deployment's own app.
entries.unsetBehavior: Device-unlock recognizes only the 'org.rabbithole.app' namespace, so your own bundle id is not treated as the app.
entries.setBy: Set RABBITHOLE_BUNDLE_IDS to match your native/app.json bundle id and its dev/metro variants.

entries.name: Guest-tutor origins
entries.description: The production and preview origins allowed to call the unauthenticated guest-tutor endpoint.
entries.publishedAs: Rabbithole's public origin and generic Rabbithole preview hosts.
entries.unsetBehavior: A separate school marketing site cannot call the endpoint directly, though the built-in Rabbithole page still can.
entries.setBy: Add your production and preview hosts to GUEST_ORIGIN_PATTERNS and GUEST_PREVIEW_ORIGIN_PATTERNS.

entries.name: Home-layout app bundle ids
entries.description: The bundle ids recognized as this deployment's native app when projecting managed-device Home Screen layouts.
entries.unsetBehavior: Devices built under another bundle namespace do not receive Rabbithole-first tile ordering.
entries.setBy: Add your production, development, and Metro bundle ids to RABBITHOLE_BUNDLE_IDS.

entries.name: Managed external apps
entries.description: The bundle ids and URL schemes of third-party iPad apps the device integration can launch.
entries.publishedAs: Three fixed third-party apps (a spreadsheet, a robotics app, a stop-motion app).
entries.unsetBehavior: The device integration manages exactly those three apps. Change MANAGED_NATIVE_APPS to manage a different set.
entries.setBy: Edit MANAGED_NATIVE_APPS (and the matching LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in native/app.json) to your own managed apps.

entries.name: Dev-client bundle namespace
entries.description: The bundle-id namespace the native dev-client-safety module uses for its stored keys.
entries.unsetBehavior: The dev-client-safety keys stay under the 'org.rabbithole.app' namespace regardless of your bundle id.
entries.setBy: Update the namespace in DevClientSafetyModule.swift to match your bundle id.

entries.name: Key-capture bundle namespace
entries.description: The bundle-id namespace the native key-capture module uses for its notification name.
entries.unsetBehavior: The key-capture notification stays under the 'org.rabbithole.app' namespace regardless of your bundle id.
entries.setBy: Update the namespace in KeyCaptureView.swift to match your bundle id.
